summary: Pantages Capital Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K disclosing shareholder approval of a one-year extension (until June 6, 2027) to complete a business combination, with monthly deposits of $0.033 per public share into the trust. Approximately 5.9M shares were redeemed at ~$10.60/share, removing ~$62.4M from trust. Post-redemption, 2.98M Class A and 2.16M Class B shares remain, with ~$29.0M in trust. This is a routine SPAC extension vote, not a special-situation event; the filing reports procedural steps. Watch for any future business combination announcement or further redemptions.
